From f58f45c1e5b92975e91754f5407250085a6ae7cf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: David Bauer <mail@david-bauer.net>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2024 15:29:08 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] vxlan: drop packets from invalid src-address

The VXLAN driver currently does not check if the inner layer2
source-address is valid.

In case source-address snooping/learning is enabled, a entry in the FDB
for the invalid address is created with the layer3 address of the tunnel
endpoint.

If the frame happens to have a non-unicast address set, all this
non-unicast traffic is subsequently not flooded to the tunnel network
but sent to the learnt host in the FDB. To make matters worse, this FDB
entry does not expire.

Apply the same filtering for packets as it is done for bridges. This not
only drops these invalid packets but avoids them from being learnt into
the FDB.

Fixes: d342894c5d2f ("vxlan: virtual extensible lan")
Suggested-by: Ido Schimmel <idosch@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: David Bauer <mail@david-bauer.net>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/drivers/net/vxlan/vxlan_core.c b/drivers/net/vxlan/vxlan_core.c
index 3495591a5c29..ba319fc21957 100644
--- a/drivers/net/vxlan/vxlan_core.c
+++ b/drivers/net/vxlan/vxlan_core.c
@@ -1615,6 +1615,10 @@ static bool vxlan_set_mac(struct vxlan_dev *vxlan,
 	if (ether_addr_equal(eth_hdr(skb)->h_source, vxlan->dev->dev_addr))
 		return false;
 
+	/* Ignore packets from invalid src-address */
+	if (!is_valid_ether_addr(eth_hdr(skb)->h_source))
+		return false;
+
 	/* Get address from the outer IP header */
 	if (vxlan_get_sk_family(vs) == AF_INET) {
 		saddr.sin.sin_addr.s_addr = ip_hdr(skb)->saddr;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/net/vxlan/vxlan_core.c`**
   - A new check has been added in the `vxlan_set_mac` function to validate the source MAC address of incoming packets. 
   - Specifically, the line `if (!is_valid_ether_addr(eth_hdr(skb)->h_source)) return false;` has been introduced to drop packets that have an invalid source address.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `vxlan_core.c` addresses a bug related to the handling of packets with invalid source addresses in the VXLAN driver. By implementing this check, the patch ensures that such packets are not only dropped but also prevents them from being learned into the Forwarding Database (FDB). This change aligns the VXLAN packet handling behavior with that of bridges, thereby enhancing the overall network integrity and preventing potential issues with non-unicast traffic being misrouted.
